extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective article creators / editors (new or unautoconfirmed users)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who find a missing Wikipedia article title and want to create or locate an article (covers account requirements, search/redirect checks, and procedural troubleshooting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation required
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only logged-in, autoconfirmed users can create pages directly. If you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed, consider using alternative submission paths (article wizard or requesting a new article).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot (or should not) create the article directly, submit a draft through the article wizard for review, or post a request for a new article so more experienced editors can assist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Late Show top ten" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling; search Wikipedia for alternative titles or spellings to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to this title (backlinks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding pages that link to the intended title can reveal existing coverage of the topic or suggest the correct canonical title and where a new page should be linked from.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may be invisible temporarily
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you believe the page exists but can't see it, wait a short time or use the purge function to refresh cached database views before creating a duplicate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case-sensitive (except first character) and use redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, if an appropriate canonical page exists under a different capitalization, create a redirect rather than a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log for removed pages
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see "Why was the page I created deleted?"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A missing title may have been deleted; consult the deletion log to learn why and whether recreation is appropriate (and to address previous deletion reasons).
